title: The Virtual World of Free-Radical Polymerization
content: The review presents the first attempt to build the virtual world of free-radical polymerization of vinyl monomers itself and in the presence of small additives of stable radicals in due course of extended virtual experiment. Chain-reaction essence of the chemical process; quantum-chemical concept of elementary reactions; spin theory of radicals; and digital-twin of their presentation lay the foundation of the world formed, which opens a new vision of the role of IT technologies for the virtualization of various chemical processes
